description: This file defines the 'SelectedDisplayField' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, using Doctrine ORM annotations. It models a database entity with relationships to 'DisplayField' and 'Report', including getter and setter methods.

classes.name: SelectedDisplayField
classes.description: Represents a selectable display field linking a 'DisplayField' and a 'Report' in the database, with ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the SelectedDisplayField.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the SelectedDisplayField.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Associates a DisplayField with this SelectedDisplayField.

methods.name: setReport
methods.description: Associates a Report with this SelectedDisplayField.
